name: FcsString
notes: i32 byte length + bytes (no terminator); text is UTF-8 or Latin-1. Observed in data/*.base,*.mod

name: FcsHeader
notes: file header of .base/.mod, filetype 16 or 17. Stream format: off = field order. v17 inserts header_size after filetype and ends with opaque tail bytes. Observed: data/*.base,*.mod + 8 workshop mods, all parse to EOF

name: FcsRecord
notes: one game-data record; stream format, off = field order. Section lists are i32 count + entries. Observed in data/*.mod

name: FcsReference
notes: link from a record to another record (by string id) within a named category, with 3 int values (fcs.def: val0..val2)

name: FcsInstance
notes: placed copy of a record inside another record (e.g. building part, town layout); stream format

name: FcsDataType
notes: record change state. v16: 0x80000000 | small n. v17: small flag set (0x10,0x11,0x13,0x40,0x90...); meaning not yet known

name: ItemType
notes: FcsRecord.type: record kind. Values and names from the FCS editor's itemType enum (FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)); the earlier key-matching derivation agreed on all 74 kinds it named

name: GameData
notes: one merged game-data record after all files are applied (F041671): kind, name, string_id, source file index, per-type field maps, references by category, instances by id

name: GameDataContainer
notes: all merged records keyed by string_id, plus id counter and loaded file list (F041671, F041658)

name: OgreMeshChunk
notes: u16 chunk ids of Ogre binary .mesh; each chunk = u16 id + u32 length (incl. 6-byte header). Source: Ogre OgreMeshFileFormat.h / OgreHardwareVertexBuffer.h (MIT, public)

name: OgreVertexElement
notes: vertex declaration element: u16 source, type, semantic, offset, index. Source: Ogre OgreMeshFileFormat.h / OgreHardwareVertexBuffer.h (MIT, public)

name: OgreVertexElementType
notes: vertex element data type. Source: Ogre OgreMeshFileFormat.h / OgreHardwareVertexBuffer.h (MIT, public)

name: OgreVertexElementSemantic
notes: vertex element meaning. Source: Ogre OgreMeshFileFormat.h / OgreHardwareVertexBuffer.h (MIT, public)

name: OgreMesh
notes: decoded .mesh: optional shared geometry, submeshes, skeleton name, bounds, mesh-level bone assignments. Observed versions in data/: MeshSerializer_v1.41, v1.8, v1.100

name: OgreSubMesh
notes: submesh: material name, shared-geometry flag, u16/u32 indices, own geometry, operation type, bone assignments

name: OgreSkeletonChunk
notes: u16 chunk ids of Ogre binary .skeleton; observed versions Serializer_v1.10 (100 files), v1.80 (264). Source: Ogre OgreSkeletonFileFormat.h (MIT, public)

name: OgreSkeleton
notes: decoded .skeleton: blend mode, bones, parent links, animations, animation links

name: OgreBone
notes: str name, u16 handle, f32x3 position, f32x4 orientation (x,y,z,w), optional f32x3 scale

name: OgreAnimation
notes: str name, f32 length, optional base info, tracks (u16 bone handle + keyframes: f32 time, f32x4 rotation x,y,z,w, f32x3 translate, optional f32x3 scale)

name: SkeletalPose
notes: per-bone local transforms of a skeleton at a time t. Ogre semantics (public Ogre docs, MIT): a keyframe is relative to the bone binding pose: position = bind_position + translate, orientation = bind_orientation * rotation, scale = bind_scale * scale; between keys linear (translate, scale) and spherical (rotation) interpolation; time wraps for looping animations

name: DdsTexture
notes: DirectDraw Surface (public format): 128-byte header (height@12, width@16, pixel-format flags@80, fourcc@84, rgb bits@88, masks@92..); DXT1/3/5 blocks; shipped hair textures are DXT3, item atlases DXT5

name: TerrainHeightmap
notes: data/newland/land/fullmap.tif: TIFF, 16385x16385, 16-bit unsigned greyscale, uncompressed single strip. World spans 294912 units (setTerrainScale in initTerrain F046700), so samples are 18 units apart; height = value / 65535 * 9800. Units look like decimetres (character ~19.5 tall).

name: ZoneFile
notes: data/newland/leveldata/<mod>/zone.X.Y.zone: FCS filetype 15 (header = id_counter, record_count only) + trailer (i32 n, n i32 ids). Zone X.Y covers world x in [X*4608-147456, +4608), z likewise with Y (64x64 grid of 4608-unit zones, world origin at the map centre). Record 30 "buildinglist": instances whose target is a game-data BUILDING are placements (world position; rotation stored w,x,y,z; states -> a type-35 state record and a type-41 record). Type 35 holds the building state incl. float "world Y pos" = true ground height (the instance y is not). Verified: world Y pos vs heightmap at col=(x+147456)/18,row=(z+147456)/18 correlates r=0.946, slope ~9500/65535.

name: TerrainColourTiles
notes: data/newland/land/overlaymaps/colour.X.Y.png: 8 x 8 RGBA PNG tiles of 2048 x 2048 = one painted colour per heightmap sample (16384^2); X = tile column (world x), Y = tile row (world z). Verified visually: colour edges follow cliffs/coasts of the heightmap. distant.png is a 128^2 version.

name: GlobalConstants
notes: the GLOBAL CONSTANTS record (110-gamedata.quack) copied into a float struct at 0x142133dd0 by loadGlobalConstants (F046688); field = float slot index (off = 4*index). Gameplay code reads these addresses directly.

name: CharStats
notes: a character's stats/skills block; offsets from CharStats::exportToGameData (F040459), names = STATS record float keys. +0x90 toughness (key "toughness2"). +0x34 used by the KO point (toughness * [+0x34] * 0.01), not yet identified.

name: BodyPart
notes: one limb/organ in MedicalSystem (array at medical+0x1a0, count +0x198). Max health = [+0x58]*[+0x54]*[+0x5c] - [+0x50]; [+0x40],[+0x44] health/damage pair; [+0x34] KO weight; [+0x32] u8 flag. Names pending.

name: MedicalSystem
notes: per-character medical state: +0x70 blood, +0xa0 knockout time, +0x198/+0x1a0 body parts (T00027), +0x1a8 CharStats* (T00026). From computeKnockoutTime (F040419).

name: StatsEnumerated
notes: stat/skill ids (race stats good/bad, heal stat, training by id); FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py). Agrees with CharStats offsets seen in training code (5 engineering +0xcc, 32 dodge +0xf0, 37 lockpicking +0xb0)

name: Armour
notes: an armour item: resistances built from its ARMOUR record by Armour::Armour (F047099); read by resolveHit (F040476)

name: LimbState
notes: a limb slot state (limbSlotState F022536): stumps cannot be hit and bleed; replaced limbs hit as plate; FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)

name: ArmourType
notes: ARMOUR "material type": indexes the material tables (armourTables F047256); also the hit material; FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)

name: ArmourClass
notes: ARMOUR "class": indexes the class tables (armourTables F047256); FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)

name: WeaponCategory
notes: weapon skill category (CharStats::setWeapon F047095 picks the skill); FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)

name: Weapon
notes: a weapon item: damage multipliers from its WEAPON record by Weapon::setupStats (F047085)

name: CombatTechnique
notes: one combat move (attack, block, dodge) from a COMBAT_TECHNIQUE record (F040738); the 'current action' combat timing reads (defendOutcome F040724)

name: CombatClass
notes: a character's fighting state machine (CombatClassAI for NPCs): state +0x1f0, desired state +0x1f4, current action +0x150 (CombatTechnique), target +0x290, attackers +0x228/+0x230, timers +0x14c/+0x274, stats +0x190

name: SwordState
notes: CombatClass state (swordStateEnum); names inferred from the state objects and transitions: 0 attack (AttackState), 1 block, 3 engaged, 4 idle, 5 circle (CircleStateAI), 6 waiting (WaitingStateAI), 8 locked, 9 target lost, 10/11 disengaging

name: SingleAnimation
notes: one playing clip in an AnimationClassBase layer: time, progress (0..1), speed, loop/sync flags, animation events (F038899, F038819)

name: AnimationLayer
notes: AnimationClassBase::AnimationLayer: active clips (+0x08/+0x10), fading clips (+0x20/+0x28), fade rate +0x40; blends SingleAnimations (F038900, F038905)

name: PerceptionShortTerm
notes: short-term subjective tags one squad keeps on another character (TagsClass bitset): intruder, aggressor, temporary enemy, criminal...; FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)

name: PerceptionLongTerm
notes: long-term subjective tags (stole from me, freed me, killed my friend...); FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)

name: CrimeEnum
notes: a character's current crime (Character +0x148), judged by witnesses (F046520); FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)

name: EventTrigger
notes: dialogue/reaction event a character raises (e.g. 41 witness assault); FCS editor metadata (forgotten construction set.exe, tools/dotnet_enums.py)

name: SubjectiveTags
notes: one squad's opinion of another character (or player squad): long-term tags +0x10, short-term tags +0x20 (TagsClass bitsets at +0x8), last set time +0x08 (game clock * 1e-6)

name: PlatoonMemory
notes: a platoon's SubjectiveTags by subject (Platoon +0x98); owner platoon +0x30

name: FactionRelations
notes: a faction's standing with others: own faction +0x08, relation entries {forced ally, relation -100..100} from the FACTION record's 'relations' references, default relation +0x60 ('default relation')

name: AnimationData
notes: one ANIMATION record as the animation class keeps it: category +0x00, name +0x08, anim name +0x30, layer +0x60 (0 lower, 1 upper, 2 overlay, 3 tail, 4 ears; 'all' +0x8b), weather type +0x64, move/max/min/play speed +0x68..+0x74, has weapon L/R +0x78/+0x7c, combat/stealth mode +0x80/+0x84 (0/1/2 = no/yes/either), relocates +0x88, disables movement +0x89, loop +0x8a, is action +0x8d, synchs +0x8c, synch offset +0x90, normalise +0x94, possible ending +0x98, crouched +0x9c, prone +0x9d, uses right/left arm +0x9e/+0x9f, carrying left/right +0xa0/+0xa1, being carried +0xa2, slave anim +0xa8, leg ranges +0xd0..+0xe4, idle time/chance +0xe8..+0xf0, events +0xf8, weapon bits +0x100, stumble parts +0x108, stumble from +0x148, big stumble +0x14c, chance +0x150

name: HavokTagfile
notes: Havok binary tagfile v5 (hk_2014.2.0-r1), magic 1e0db0ca cefa11d0; sign-in-bit-0 varints; tags 1 info / 2 class / 4 object / 7 end; string table ["", null]; objects numbered from 1, members by presence bits (parents first); struct arrays stored member-wise; int arrays lead with width 4, vec4 arrays with floats per element (4 or 3). src/io/hkt.rs; every sampled navtile parses to EOF

name: NavTileSection
notes: navtiles/tileX.Y.hkt root variants per navmesh: NavMesh (hkaiNavMesh), Graph (hkaiDirectedGraphExplicitCost clusters), Mediator, Info (buildings: "uidhex;x;y;z" world units), Hash. Ground mesh local to the tile corner (zone cell X.Y), building meshes local to the Info position, metres, Y up. uid: ground Y*256+X, building = Info hex; streaming sets link edges and cluster nodes across uids. faceData = Kenshi face type (3 water, 4 costly, 5 blocked; -1/1 plain). src/world/navmesh.rs

name: TaskDefinition
notes: per task type, built by TaskSystem::register (F039864, ctor F039921): flags +0x8, alias +0xc, follow-up +0x10, duration +0x18/+0x1c, interrupts +0x4c/+0x50 (11), steps +0xa8/+0xac (11), score PMF +0x108, prerequisite +0x128, debug name +0x138, hook +0x160; table in src/ai/task_def.rs
